Same page lists export counterparties "TO ORDER - BANGLADESH" (236 shipments), "TO ORDER - SRILANKA" (125), "TO ORDER, JORDAN" (25) and "PON PURE CHEMICAL LANKA (PRIVATE)" (25). Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 5993 Records detected", "Trading Partners 121", "Ports 133", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually visible in the free view = 5 shipment rows (4 import + 1 export) plus aggregated partner tables — so only a small fraction of the 5993 counter was verifiable.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, company site ponpurechemicals.com failed TLS (SSL UNEXPECTED_EOF), and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) for all queries. Domestic supply therefore not verified — null, not inferred from the company's own catalogue or IndiaMART presence.
note: Legal entity exists and is active in customs data (latest record 2026-02-28), so no rejection ground. Role: trader/distributor — the visible rows show it importing bulk chemicals (melamine HS 29336100 from China, toluene HS 29023000 from South Korea, butyl diglycol HS 29094300 from USA, DPG HS 29094990 from Singapore) and re-exporting (e.g. HS 39072990 to Vietnam). Declared HS codes 130219/293359/293369/293399 do not match any observed shipment line (observed: 29336100, 39072990, 29094300, 29023000, 29094990) — per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground; the code should be corrected to the factual codes and the verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Export shipments are factually confirmed with date, destination, HS and B/L. Domestic (India) supply evidence: not found in accessible sources — stated as unknown, not as 'conditionally accepted'. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in free views; the 5993 figure is a shipment-record counter, not a value). PAN AACCP3026E and state Maharashtra were not independently verified (registry lookups blocked); note the ImportKey address shown is Anna Nagar, Chennai (Tamil Nadu), which conflicts with the claimed Maharashtra state — worth a registry check.
